exposure: Poor glucose control (elevated 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test results)
Placental dysfunction markers (soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1, sFlt-1)
cohort: The study included 122 pregnancies preceding active labor (77 with pregestational DM and 45 with gestational DM) between 2001 and 2017.
finding: In pregestational DM, increased circulating FMc correlated with elevated HbA1c (>= 6.0%) and a rise in sFlt-1; in GDM, increased FMc correlated with elevated 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test results and birthweight < 10th or > 90th percentile.
